name: Tampa Scale of Kinesiophobia
description: 11-item self-report questionnaire measuring fear of movement and (re)injury. Higher scores = greater kinesiophobia.
shirleySays: ICC 0.80–0.87. MDC: ~5 pts. MCID: ~5 pts. Cronbach α 0.79–0.83. Validated in chronic LBP, fibromyalgia, CRPS, post-surgical knee/shoulder, whiplash. Screens for yellow flag avoidance behavior. Short 11-item version preferred in clinical settings.
